note: Views Migration migrates Drupal 6/7 Views into D10/11 view config entities (core migrate_drupal skips Views). Ships migrations d7_views_migration and d6_views_migration in migration group views_migration, source plugins d7_views_migration/d6_views_migration, destination plugin entity:view. Run via migrate_tools drush (migrate:import/status/rollback, --idlist); a form alter adds a 'Views ID List' field for the group. Extensible via 21 plugin managers plugin.manager.migrate.views.<type> (access, area, argument, field, filter, sort, ... ) with @MigrateViews<Type> annotations and default d7_default plugins; custom handler plugins live in Plugin/migrate/views/<type>/d7 and implement alterHandlerConfig(). No permissions, no config schema, no own Drush commands, no configure route. Medium/hard cases are grounded in real migrate_plus.migration config entities (migration group membership, source/destination plugins).

evals.prompt: What does the Drupal views_migration module do that core's migrate_drupal does not, which migrations does it provide, and how do you run the Drupal 7 one?
evals.expected_output: Core migrate_drupal does not migrate Views; views_migration does. It ships migrations d7_views_migration and d6_views_migration (group views_migration) that read legacy view data and write Drupal view config entities (destination entity:view). Run with migrate_tools: drush migrate:import d7_views_migration.

evals.prompt: What must be set up before running the Drupal views_migration migrations, and which modules does it depend on?
evals.expected_output: It depends on views, migrate, migrate_drupal, migrate_tools and migrate_plus. You must configure a Drupal 6/7 source database first (via the core Upgrade / migrate_upgrade flow or a migrate DB connection in settings.php); views_migration itself does not configure the connection.

evals.prompt: In the Drupal views_migration module, how would I customize how one particular Views handler (say a specific field) is migrated from Drupal 7? What kind of plugin do I create?
evals.expected_output: Add an annotated plugin class (e.g. @MigrateViewsField for a field, one of 21 plugin types) under src/Plugin/migrate/views/<type>/d7/ extending MigrateViewsHandlerPluginBase (or MigrateViewsPluginPluginBase), with an id matching the handler, implementing alterHandlerConfig(). The manager uses it instead of the default d7_default plugin. Clear caches to discover it.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, a migration named vm_known has been added. Inspect the live migration configuration and state which migration group it belongs to.
evals.expected_output: vm_known belongs to the views_migration migration group (migrate_plus.migration.vm_known: migration_group = views_migration), the same group as the shipped d7_views_migration/d6_views_migration migrations.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a migration named vm_inspect provided for testing. Inspect the live migration configuration and state which source plugin it uses.
evals.expected_output: vm_inspect (label 'VM Inspect Me') uses the source plugin d6_views_migration (migrate_plus.migration.vm_inspect: source.plugin = d6_views_migration), the module's Drupal 6 Views source.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, create a new migrate_plus migration with id vm_task that uses the views_migration module's Drupal 7 Views source plugin and its Views destination, placed in the views_migration migration group. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: A migrate_plus.migration.vm_task config entity exists with migration_group: views_migration, source.plugin: d7_views_migration and destination.plugin: entity:view (create via Migration::create([...])->save() or a migrate_plus config import).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a migration vm_fix whose source and destination plugins are placeholders (source 'empty', destination 'null'). Reconfigure vm_fix to use the views_migration module's Drupal 7 Views source plugin and its Views destination plugin, and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: migrate_plus.migration.vm_fix now has source.plugin: d7_views_migration and destination.plugin: entity:view (load the migration, set its source and destination plugin ids, and save).
